summary: Gunmen fired a rocket-propelled grenade and rifles at the two-vehicle convoy of Shariff Aguak Mayor Akmad 'Mitra' Ampatuan Sr., a Maguindanao massacre witness, in Barangay Poblacion, Shariff Aguak, Maguindanao del Sur, at about 6:30 a.m. on Sunday, January 25, 2026; the mayor was unharmed and two of his security escorts were wounded. The attackers fled in a minivan and three of them were killed by pursuing forces in Barangay Meta, Datu Unsay, the same day. President Marcos condemned the attack and the PNP formed a task group, eyeing hired gunmen, local politics and revenge as motives. A Department of Justice resolution of 28 August 2026 found probable cause against 12 people, and in September the Iligan City Regional Trial Court issued warrants for them, among them Datu Unsay Mayor Datu Andal 'Xyril' Ampatuan V, on charges of frustrated murder and terrorism. On 24 October 2026 police arrested Toraipe Lusod, alias Aripi Adam, the alleged RPG gunman, in Barangay Meta, Datu Unsay, with an M4 rifle.
